description: §6.7.7 a change to a `deps=` variable RE-EXECUTES the fetch (RUNTIME, sqlEngine:"real"). deps=[@ver]; @userId is set to 2 (unlisted, no re-fire), then @ver is bumped: the fetch re-runs and reads the CURRENT @userId, so @userData becomes user 2 ("b") and .loading settles false. This is the manual invalidate-after-write idiom (bump a version cell). Twin of request-deps-explicit-unlisted-no-refire-rt.
rationale: §6.7.7 Re-execution: "The fetch re-executes when: … Any `@variable` in `deps=` changes". Pre-S444 the parsed deps attribute read as [] so the explicit list was dropped (g-request-deps-attr-ignored-both-forms).
